newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-KLUIVERT GOAL EARNS AJAX QUARTER-FINAL PLACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KLUIVERT GOAL EARNS AJAX QUARTER-FINAL PLACE.

text.p: A first-half strike by Patrick Kluivert propelled Ajax Amsterdam to a 1-0 victory over Grasshopper Zurich on Wednesday and secured a place in the European Cup quarter-finals.
Needing nothing less than a win in their last Champions' League group A match to reach the last eight for the third consecutive year, Ajax attacked from the outset.
The Amsterdam club's persistence was rewarded in the 31st minute when Tijani Babangida spotted Kluivert unmarked near the penalty area.
Taking a perfect pass from the Nigerian winger, Kluivert blasted a low shot to the left corner past flat-footed goalkeeper Pascal Zuberbuehler.
The goal silenced most of the sold-out crowd of 22,000 that had crammed into Hardturm stadium on a bitterly cold evening hoping to see Grasshopper qualify for the quarter-finals for the first time.
